note: Hand-edit 'emotions', then run `uv run emotions` (sheet + report) and `uv run export`. Each part (upper = brows/lids/eyes, lower = mouth/cheeks/jaw) is built from: labels = weighted GNM sampler labels (1.0 = one typical sample), components = extra σ on single GNM expression components, goals = millimetre changes solved on that part (brows: inner_brow_raise, outer_brow_raise, brow_raise, brow_knit; lids: lid_aperture, lower_lid_raise; mouth: corner_raise, lip_part, mouth_stretch, jaw_open, upper_lip_raise, lip_thickness, lip_protrude, mouth_shift), free = measures the goals may change. Goals are TOTAL changes (labels included). 'sampler' and 'labels' are written by tools/gnm_sampler; do not edit them.

sampler.source: GNM ExpressionSampler (gnm/shape/semantic_sampler.py, expression_decoder_model.h5), Google LLC, Apache-2.0
sampler.note: labels.<LABEL>.mean = average of the samples, 383 values in GNM's expression order (σ units).
